summary.zh: 郑和率船队从太仓刘家港起航，开始第一次下西洋。
summary.en: Zheng He’s fleet sets sail from Liujiagang, Taicang, beginning the first voyage.

description.zh: 1405 年 7 月 11 日，郑和率两百余艘船、两万余人从太仓刘家港起航。
description.en: On July 11, 1405, Zheng He led more than 200 ships and over 20,000 men from Liujiagang, Taicang.
